preserved_analysis.summary: A Yale student alleges that GPTZero misclassification contributed to a one-year suspension and failing grade after an exam was suspected of AI assistance. Yale disputes his account and says the disciplinary process relied on additional evidence and conduct, leaving the detector’s causal role contested.
preserved_analysis.why_it_matters_to_CAM: Probabilistic AI-authorship scores can acquire institutional authority when embedded in academic discipline even though such detectors have known limitations. The disputed record is useful monitoring evidence but does not yet establish a standalone failure mechanism or Yale liability.
